'''Shulin''' (Japanese: '''シュリン''' ''Shulin'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]].

==History==
Shulin first appeared in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', where she competed in the [[Fleurrh City]] Rookie Class [[Pokémon Showcase]]. However, she was ranked fourth out of the final five competitors.

She reappeared in ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', where she entered the [[Gloire City]] Master Class Pokémon Showcase. She participated in the first round, among the third group of [[Pokémon Performer|Performers]], with her {{p|Accelgor}}, but was eliminated.
